## How to Deploy

1. Import the component into your blog routing/data file
2. Add the route `/blog/cannabis-near-logan-airport-guide`
3. Set `<title>` and `<meta name="description">` from the `metaTitle` and `metaDescription` constants
4. Deploy via Netlify (auto-deploys on merge to main)
5. Submit URL to Google Search Console after deploy
6. Share on Google Business Profile as a post
